_note: Chapter 2 (Selwyn 23 Oct: 'More stories/plots'). Begins once the Heartstone chapter is done. Someone is quietly taking light from the old shrines of every region, ahead of the girls; they follow her trail across all six regions (the ash marks are PlaceSpots with this chapter), learn who she is and why, and end it with a gift, not a fight. Clues are knowledge the girls really gain at a spot; leads are only what they have a reason to know (after: any of these clues or knowledge first).
title: The Lamplighter's Trail
start_text: The night after the Heartstone woke, the little wayshrine in the Whispering Woods went dark. Its candle was not blown out. Its light was taken.
premise: Since the Heartstone woke, someone has been following its echo through the old places of the realm, taking a little light from each old flame and leaving a grey mark shaped like a snuffed flame. Who is it, and why?

ash_woods.title: A snuffed flame in the woods
ash_woods.hint: The woods' wayshrine has a grey mark shaped like a snuffed flame. Its light was taken, not blown out.

ash_grove.title: The guardian's missing eye
ash_grove.hint: The grove guardian's lantern eye was lifted out, the same grey ash around it.

lightless.title: A lantern that gives no light
lightless.hint: A hooded traveller bought all the village's blue lamp oil. Her lantern gave no light.

ash_river.title: The dark reeds
ash_river.hint: A circle of the river's glowing reeds was drained dark, as if a lantern drank it.

cut_crystal.title: A crystal cut by a spell
cut_crystal.hint: A great crystal spire in the caverns was sliced off by a spell.

ledger.title: Borrowed by S.
ledger.hint: Books on drawing light from old flames, borrowed by S. and never returned.

expelled.title: Sable Wren
expelled.hint: The academy once expelled a student, Sable Wren, for taking light from the practice crystals.

ash_high.title: Boot prints going up
ash_high.hint: The same mark on a mountain cairn, and fresh boot prints heading up to the summit.

letter.title: Sable's letter
letter.hint: Sable's village, Duskmere, lost every light when its keeper died. She takes a little from each old flame to light it again.

gift.title: A light sent north
gift.hint: From the wish stone at Lantern Lake they sent a light of their own north to Duskmere.

stages.title: Grey Marks
stages.objective: Find out what happened to the wayshrine in the Whispering Woods.

stages.title: A Lantern Without Light
stages.objective: Follow the grey marks and find out who carries the lightless lantern.

stages.title: The Trail North
stages.objective: The marks lead on. Find out who the traveller is.

stages.title: Sable
stages.objective: Follow the boot prints to the summit.

stages.title: The Letter
stages.objective: Decide what to do about Sable and Duskmere.

stages.title: Light Given
stages.objective: Duskmere has a light of its own again. Sable may write one day.

leads.lead: look at the dark wayshrine in the Whispering Woods
check the old guardian at the grove shrine for the same mark
ask around the village whether anyone saw a stranger with a lantern
see if the river's glowing reeds were touched too
look for missing light in the crystal caverns
ask at the academy whether a mage was ever caught taking light
find out who borrowed the books on drawing light
follow the trail north up the mountain path
follow the boot prints to the summit
send a light of our own north to Duskmere from the wish stone at Lantern Lake, at night

finale.text: you came to the wish stone at night to send a light of your own north to Duskmere, for Sable's village. Each of you puts a little of your own magic into a lantern and lets it go across the lake. Say what you wish for Sable and Duskmere, and how it feels to end it this way instead of chasing her.

unlock.summary: A light went north to Duskmere. Somewhere in the dark valley, a window is lit again.
